full_prompt_en: A square Renaissance-style painted scene centers on a pale young woman shown from the upper chest upward against a nearly black background. She faces the viewer with a calm, closed-lipped expression. Her forehead is high, the nose narrow, and the eyes softly defined in cool gray-brown. A muted gold crown with small raised ornaments sits above a closely fitted cloth band. A long gray-green veil descends from the crown on either side of her face and shoulders, making a symmetrical frame around the illuminated skin. A fine necklace is visible at the base of her neck. Two other faces emerge from deep shadow behind her. At the far left, only the right portion of a dark-haired man's face and a dark cap are visible; his gaze turns toward the center. At the right, a hooded figure leans slightly inward, with one eye and part of the nose and mouth caught by low warm light. The three heads make a shallow triangular group, but the woman's pale oval remains the unmistakable center. The background offers no clear architecture or landscape, just dark space around the figures. Light falls softly from the front left, brightening the central forehead, nose, and cheek while the side faces retain deeper olive-brown shadows. The paint surface is smooth around the face and more textured in the jeweled crown, woven veil, and dark garments. Colors are restrained: aged gold, olive gray, warm ivory, and near-black brown. The composition is formal and compressed, with heads cropped at both sides to intensify the central gaze. No readable text appears. The image feels solemn and intimate, its quiet drama arising from the transition between luminous face and surrounding darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形文艺复兴风格绘画把一位浅肤色年轻女子从上胸以上置于几乎黑色的背景前。她正对观者，嘴唇闭合，神情平静。前额高，鼻梁窄，眼睛以冷灰褐色柔和刻画。低调金色冠饰带小小凸起装饰，坐在贴头布带之上。长长灰绿色面纱从冠饰两侧垂下，顺着面部与肩膀下降，对称地框住受光皮肤。颈根可见一条细项链。另两张脸从她身后的深影里浮现。最左边只露出一名深发男子脸的右侧部分和深色帽子，目光转向中央。右边一名戴头巾的人略向内倾，一只眼和部分鼻、嘴接住低调暖光。三个头组成浅浅的三角群，但女子浅色椭圆脸仍是明确中心。背景不交代建筑或风景，只有包围人物的深暗空间。光从正面偏左柔和落下，照亮中央的额头、鼻子与脸颊，两侧面孔留在更深橄榄褐影中。面部颜料表面平滑，珠饰冠、织纹面纱与深衣则更有肌理。配色克制：旧金、橄榄灰、暖象牙白和近黑褐色。构图正式且紧密，两侧人物头部被画框裁断，使中央目光更强。没有可读文字。影像肃穆、亲近，安静戏剧性来自发亮面部与周围黑暗之间的过渡。
style_prompt_en: Early Renaissance-style painting uses precise, softly lit facial modeling against a deep nearly black field. A pale central oval is framed by muted fabric planes and small aged-gold details, while secondary forms recede into olive-brown shadow at the sides. The composition is frontal, compressed, and gently symmetrical, with shallow triangular grouping rather than an expansive setting. Smooth translucent transitions in skin contrast with fine jewel, weave, and garment textures. Light is restrained and directional, giving the brightest forehead and cheek quiet emphasis without theatrical glare. Aged gold, gray-green, ivory, and dark umber create a solemn, intimate color structure. Slight surface patina preserves the sense of an old painted object.
style_prompt_zh: 早期文艺复兴式绘画在近黑的深色场域前，精细而柔和地塑造受光面部。浅色中央椭圆由低调布面和细小旧金装饰围住，次要形体在两侧退入橄榄褐影。构图正面、紧密且轻度对称，以浅三角群组代替广阔场景。皮肤平滑而半透明的明暗过渡，对照珠饰、织纹与衣料的细致肌理。光线克制且有方向，让最亮的额头与脸颊获得安静重点，没有戏剧性眩光。陈旧金、灰绿、象牙白和深赭褐形成肃穆、亲密的色彩结构。轻微表面包浆保留旧画物件感。
theme_en: A pale crowned woman between two shadowed attendants
theme_zh: 面色苍白的冠饰女子立于两名暗影侍者之间
name: Antonello da Messina
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
